create_DualChunkFlashAttentionBackend: create a DualChunkFlashAttentionBackend instance for a model runner with dual chunk flash attention and sparse attention support
init_forward_metadata: initialize forward metadata for prefill or decode mode with sequence lengths, block tables, and scaling factors
forward_extend: run dual chunk flash attention prefill forward pass splitting queries into intra, succ, and inter components
forward_decode: run dual chunk flash attention decoding forward pass with intra, succ, and inter attention stages
run_sparse_vertical_slash_attention: run sparse vertical and slash attention using converted indexes and sparse_attn_func
